_readme: Company-announced report dates that beat Finnhub's projection (ticket 0013). Company releases only; every entry needs an https source and a checked date within 30 days (npm test enforces it). quarter/year are Finnhub's labels for that report. hour is the company's stated session (bmo, amc, dmh); leave it out when the release names none (never copy an aggregator's time). call is the notice's call time ("3:30 p.m. CT"): when hour is left out, a call before 9:30 a.m. ET settles bmo and one at 4 p.m. ET or later settles amc (0108); a call during market hours settles nothing, and Nasdaq's timed listing for that day then shows as expected. Entries stop applying 14 days after their date; delete them then.
